name: outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{P : Sort u} →
  {d n : ℕ} →
    {L σ ε Δ : ℝ} →
      {x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d} →
        {power : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ} →
          {d' n' : ℕ} →
            {L' σ' ε' Δ' : ℝ} →
              {x0' : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d'} →
                {power' : Fin n' → ℝ → ℝ} →
                  { d := d, n := n, L := L, σ := σ, ε := ε, Δ := Δ, x0 := x0, power := power } =
                      { d := d', n := n', L := L', σ := σ', ε := ε', Δ := Δ', x0 := x0', power := power' } →
                    (d = d' → n = n' → L = L' → σ = σ' → ε = ε' → Δ = Δ' → x0 ≍ x0' → power ≍ power' → P) → P
